originalBoundary.note: Records timestamped after the boundary and all lines from the first such record onward are excluded.

agentToolResultSummaries.scopeNote: Recorded by the harness for the direct child only. totalTokens equals input+cache_creation+cache_read+output of the usage object, which matches the child's final API call, not a cumulative or whole-tree sum.

costStateRecords.scope: Session cumulative state written after the first excluded follow-up turn (between follow-up turns); it covers excluded work, and whether it includes subagent usage is not stated in the record. Not an original-run total.

findings.dedupRule: Assistant records are grouped by message.id; each id is one request (requestIds are unique 1:1). Usage is kept from the last record of each id. Where duplicates differ (4 messages in a6d121234b148a246, 95 in af511f0e6dd3dc08b), only output_tokens differs and the last record holds the largest value; all variants are preserved in usageVariantsInRecordOrder.
